summary: Implemented a narrow orbit render repair: render setup now initializes and warms from the first light setting instead of orbit_spec light_baseline_settings, supports a true no-flashlight-ever scene-off diagnostic, and writes honest render-history verification metadata. Unit tests pass; live SPEAR rerender was not run in this turn.
work_completed: Removed render-mode dependency on orbit_spec light_baseline_settings for setup warm-up; initial setup now uses the first per-setting light command or no spawned flashlight when that setting requests it.
Added optional light setting field spawn_flashlight=false, validated it, and made capture/warm-up paths support no flashlight actor for diagnostic controls.

Marked scene_off_flashlight_off in examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json as spawn_flashlight=false so scene-off setup and warm-up do not spawn or enable the baseline flashlight before this control.
Added render diagnostics metadata including initial setup source, flashlight ever-spawned/ever-enabled state before each setting, no_flashlight_ever_control, and render_history_disable_verified.
Updated deterministic capture metadata so render-history disable is reported as verified only when capture-component readback confirms it; unverified components are listed instead of overclaiming.
Updated docs to describe the no-flashlight-ever control and the verification semantics for render-history metadata.
Added focused tests for no-flashlight warm-up capture, spawn_flashlight validation, first-setting setup selection, no-baseline initial setup, and honest render-history metadata.
Ran python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation: 43 tests passed.

findings.message: Exact rerender command for live validation: examples/flashlight/run_orbit_workflow.sh render --output-dir examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation

Live SPEAR rerender/output-image validation was not run here, so the remaining gap is simulator-side confirmation that scene_off_flashlight_off is dark or, if still bright, that the new no_flashlight_ever_control metadata distinguishes residual environment/static/material lighting from flashlight leakage.
The worktree already contained uncommitted changes in the same area; this implementation was layered without reverting unrelated user or prior-agent changes.

follow_up_recommendations: Run the rerender command and inspect scene_off_flashlight_off/metadata.json for render_diagnostics.no_flashlight_ever_control=true and render_history_disable_verified state.

If scene_off_flashlight_off remains bright with no_flashlight_ever_control=true, treat the remaining brightness as environment/static/material lighting and repair the map/render environment rather than the flashlight warm-up path.
Have Inspector review the live output after rerender, especially scene_off_flashlight_off luma, scene_off_flashlight_on beam locality, and metadata readback fields.
memory_worthy: Orbit render setup now avoids orbit_spec light_baseline_settings during render warm-up; scene_off_flashlight_off is a spawn_flashlight=false no-flashlight-ever control with metadata diagnostics for baseline leakage versus residual scene lighting.
